verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own background automation within release management. Rollouts can progress through milestones automatically while monitoring application health, and safeguards can pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics such as error rate or latency cross a threshold. Scheduled change requests add one-off timed application of changes. These automations are limited to the feature-rollout domain rather than general-purpose autonomous workflows, and the scheduling evidence covers one-off timed changes, not a recurring schedule. missing for 10: general-purpose automation/workflow builder beyond rollouts, recurring scheduled jobs, depth on how automations are configured and monitored, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
